# Avishek Kait

> Avishek Kait (AK) is a Computer Science & Engineering student at the University of Global Village (UGV) in Barishal, Bangladesh, and a competitive programmer. He works in C, C++, Java and Python and is seeking internship and entry-level opportunities.

Expected graduation: 2029. Based in Barishal, Bangladesh. Languages: Bangla (native), English (working proficiency), German (basic).

Skills: C, C++, Java, Python, HTML, CSS, SQL, NumPy, Java Swing, C++ STL, Data Structures and Algorithms, Object-Oriented Programming, Git, GitHub, Linux.
